name: view_stack_banners
description: The banners of stacked waves (M8, design 2.7 and 5.7): a call once wave 1 has set out sounds its horn as it lands with 'Wave 2 called early · +N gold', N what it paid (the window it skips and the stake: the gold went up by exactly that), not wave 2's own title; then each wave clears on its own banner with its own bonus, wave 1 while wave 2 still walks (the strip back to 'Wave 2/12') and wave 2 into the window. Each banner's lives lost are its own wave's creeps', as the results' leak table counts them: wave 2's first creep, sent to the Holdfast before wave 1 cleared, counts on wave 2's banner, not on wave 1's (whose banner counted the lives lost since its horn).

steps.assert: paid >= 10 and node('BannerTitle').text == 'Wave 2 called early · +%d gold' % paid
steps.msg: the stacked horn's banner says what the call paid: the gold went up by exactly that
wave 2's first creep is on the road
it got through while wave 1 still walks

steps.assert: Game.state == 1 and Game.waves_on_road() == PackedInt32Array([2]) and node('Wave').text == 'Wave 2/12'
steps.msg: wave 1 cleared while wave 2 walks on
by then both waves' creeps had got through

steps.assert: node('BannerTitle').text == 'Wave 1 cleared · %d lives lost · +10 gold' % scene.leaks_in(1)['lives']
steps.msg: its own banner, its own bonus (8 + 2), the lives its own creeps took

steps.assert: node('BannerTitle').text == 'Wave 2 cleared · %d lives lost · +12 gold' % scene.leaks_in(2)['lives'] and 200 - Game.lives == scene.leaks_in(1)['lives'] + scene.leaks_in(2)['lives']
steps.msg: wave 2 clears into the window: its own bonus, the lives its creeps took, the first among them
